about: bsv-low #836 (loop 44, record 1066, 2026-10-22): Arcade's REJECTED for a pre-signed refund presented at its lock height while Arcade's peer answered thirteen blocks behind the chain (the chain's tip 972185, the peer's 972172). Two refunds (pot_evictions 1902ca00afb99f73... at 16:53:08Z and c76c3a09634c316c... at 16:52:58Z) were evicted on it. The bodies are frozen from the ledger's reason (the extraInfo verbatim: 'TX_LOCK_TIME (35): lock time (972185) as block height is not less than block height (972172)') joined to Arcade's own non-final suffix as arcade@85bfe5d writes it (services/propagation/propagator.go:1796-1798, classifyFailureLine: TX_LOCK_TIME maps to 476 StatusNotFinal and gains the retryable hint); the HTTP bytes themselves were not captured. Placeholders: {TXID} the subject txid. Expectations are this overlay's readings (bsv-low #836): a non-final word is 'not now', never a refusal, never an eviction. bsv-low #836 fold (the lens's M1, 2026-10-22): every reading runs under the chain's bound, the subject's own lock height from its bytes ('subject_lock_height', the refunds' nLockTime; a case's 'subject_lock: final' is a subject final by its bytes) against the tip: 'expect' at 'chain_tip' (inside the window), 'expect_past_lag' at 'chain_tip_past_lag' (the lock height plus door_words::NOT_FINAL_LAG_BLOCKS, 24, passed: Arcade's fatal word again, judged as any other). The lens's L1: the push is the evidence check's, never held on its text. The first body's 'status': 476 is an assumption about the GET body's shape, read by no check (the lens's N3).
